method: LoRA-inspired rank-8 raw-preserving feature residual adapter

loss.rank_definition: mean softplus(s_neg - s_pos) over every explicit positive and hard negative
loss.safe_definition: relu(detached raw positive margin - adapted margin), only when detached raw margin > 0

data: Phase30 fit episodes only; one video/category-disjoint fold per model
controller: not run unless both Phase75E global and legal strict R gates pass
